meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以在 NanoClaw 的 agent 容器内把附件中的 Word、PowerPoint、Excel 等办公文档转成 Markdown 再阅读,文件留在容器本地,不经过托管解析服务。
howto.when: 当 agent 需要读取附带的 Word、Excel、PDF 等办公文档,又不希望把文件上传给托管解析服务时触发。

say.text: 把 inbox 里那个 docx 转成 Markdown 再总结
say.note: 转存到本地目录后只摘取相关段落

say.text: 把这个 xlsx 转成 Markdown,并说明它不能作为计算依据
say.note: 会标出表格 Markdown 不代表计算结果

say.text: 这个 PDF 是扫描件吗?是的话直接报错、不要上传
say.note: 纯图片 PDF 会明确失败,不上传

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can convert attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel and other office files to Markdown inside the NanoClaw agent container and read them there; documents stay local and are not sent to a hosted parser.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an agent needs to read attached Word, Excel, PDF and similar files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

say_en.text: Convert the .docx in inbox to Markdown, then summarize it
say_en.note: Saves to the converted dir, summarizes relevant sections

say_en.text: Turn this .xlsx into Markdown; note it isn't authoritative for calculations
Is this PDF scanned? If so, fail clearly without uploading it
say_en.note: Image-only PDFs fail; nothing gets uploaded
